name: Trigger: OnFirstWindowOpen
purpose: File-open trigger of the Build file: makes sure one meta record and one System record exist (creating them if missing), caches the Otto Migrator data source in $$OttoMigratorDataSource, runs the selector and virtual list start-up scripts, goes to the Change layout, omits changes that still have a deprecated FileBuild id, and shows the menu bar and toolbars.
calls:
karbon_Build.fmp12/scripts/344 "Selector Connector: On System Startup" (step 26)
karbon_Build.fmp12/scripts/354 "Virtual List: On Startup" (step 27)
open_question: The whole karbon_Build file looks like developer release tooling; confirm it is out of scope. Also called from kontacts System_Startup, which is outside this share.

name: Trigger: OnLastWindowClose
purpose: File-close trigger of the Build file: when the file is not hosted, sets multi-user hidden and resets the toolbar, menubar and window size. FileMaker window chrome only.
